summary: South Park Commons has a current Founder Fellowship page stating Fall 2026 applications open in summer and the cohort starts in late September; exact opening and deadline dates are not yet public.

proposed_event.name: South Park Commons Founder Fellowship Fall 2026
proposed_event.description: Pre-idea founder fellowship with $1M funding, credits, partner mentorship, and SPC community access.

dates.date_range_text: Applications for Fall 2026 open in summer 2026; cohort kicks off in late September 2026.

sources.title: Founder Fellowship — South Park Commons
sources.supports: Official page says applications for the Fall 2026 cohort open in summer, the cohort kicks off in late September, terms are $400k upfront for 7% plus $600k in the next external round, and credits/perks are offered.

sources.title: FAQ - South Park Commons
sources.supports: Official FAQ says Fellowship cohorts run in spring and fall with application cutoffs before cohort starts, $1M funding terms, no demo day requirement, and Member Residency is a separate six-month rolling path.

sources.title: SPC Founder Fellowship Spring 2026
sources.supports: Official blog post documents recent Fellowship structure: $1M funding, partner mentorship, credits, in-person bootcamp logistics, and sector-agnostic founder focus; Spring 2026 deadline is past and not used as current.

notes: Exact Fall 2026 application open date, close date, and bootcamp start/end dates are not published as of 2026-06-09.
The Spring 2026 application deadline was 2026-02-01 and is stale, so it was not used for proposed_event dates.

Official current Fellowship page mentions San Francisco and New York City for bootcamp; broader SPC FAQ says active hubs are San Francisco, New York City, and Bangalore. Location is kept at country/region level because the Fall 2026 cohort page does not assign a single city.
